description_en: Modifies the display policy of a delivery group, including settings such as frame rate, resolution, and protocol type
description_zh: 修改交付组显示策略，包括帧率、分辨率、协议类型等设置
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center modify-app-policy --product-type CloudApp --app-policy-id pg-ee2znjktwgxu20000 --video-policy TerminalResolutionAdaptive=false SessionResolutionWidth=1920 FrameRate=60 SessionResolutionHeight=1080 StreamingMode=video VisualQualityStrategy=smooth Webrtc=true --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAppPolicy

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use adaptive resolution.

- `true`: The session resolution follows changes in the terminal display area. In this case, SessionResolutionWidth and SessionResolutionHeight specify the maximum resolution values.

- `false`: The session resolution does not follow changes in the terminal display area. In this case, the resolution is fixed to the values of SessionResolutionWidth and SessionResolutionHeight
fields.help_zh:
是否使用自适应分辨率。

- `true`：会话分辨率跟随终端显示区域变化。此时`SessionResolutionWidth`和`SessionResolutionHeight`为分辨率变化的最大值。

- `false`：会话分辨率不跟随终端显示区域变化。此时分辨率固定为`SessionResolutionWidth`和`SessionResolutionHeight`的值
fields.name: terminal_resolution_adaptive

fields.help_en: The width of the resolution, in pixels
fields.help_zh: 分辨率的宽度，单位为像素
fields.name: session_resolution_width

fields.help_en: The height of the resolution, in pixels
fields.help_zh: 分辨率的高度，单位为像素
fields.name: session_resolution_height

fields.help_en:
The streaming mode. Used together with the Webrtc parameter to specify the protocol type.

- Webrtc=`true` and StreamingMode=`video`: WebRTC stream.
- Webrtc=`false` and StreamingMode=`video`: video stream.
- Webrtc=`false` and StreamingMode=`mix`: mixed stream
fields.help_zh:
流模式。与`Webrtc`参数搭配表示协议类型。

- `Webrtc`=`true`且`StreamingMode`=`video`，表示WebRTC流。
- `Webrtc`=`false`且`StreamingMode`=`video`，表示视频流。
- `Webrtc`=`false`且`StreamingMode`=`mix`，表示混合流
fields.name: streaming_mode

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable WebRTC. Used together with the StreamingMode parameter to specify the protocol type.

- Webrtc=`true` and StreamingMode=`video`: WebRTC stream.
- Webrtc=`false` and StreamingMode=`video`: video stream.
- Webrtc=`false` and StreamingMode=`mix`: mixed stream
fields.help_zh:
是否开启WebRTC。与`StreamingMode`参数搭配表示协议类型。

- `Webrtc`=`true`且`StreamingMode`=`video`，表示WebRTC流。
- `Webrtc`=`false`且`StreamingMode`=`video`，表示视频流。
- `Webrtc`=`false`且`StreamingMode`=`mix`，表示混合流
fields.name: webrtc
